questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Bissau?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Guinea-Bissau is Bissau.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Guinea-Bissau on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Guinea-Bissau on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: What money is used in Guinea-Bissau?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the part of the article about the economy, or at the facts for the country.

questions.proof: The money used in Guinea-Bissau is the West African CFA franc.

questions.prompt: True or false: “The capital city of Guinea-Bissau is Bissau.”

hints.nudge: Read the statement slowly. Does it match what the article says, or has one word been swapped for another?
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guinea-Bissau article, or on the Atlas.

questions.proof: The capital city of Guinea-Bissau is Bissau.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Guinea-Bissau?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guinea-Bissau article.

questions.proof: The official language is Portuguese, and the capital is Bissau.
